Hi Alex — great to meet you.

Short answer: yes, we can run that and we want EU engineers live too. A quick heads-up on DST: the US switches to DST on Sun Mar 14, while most of EU switches on Sun Mar 28. Between Mar 14–28 the offset between PT/ET and CET is shifted by one hour compared to the rest of March; we expect potential confusion if invites are created before the US change and not updated.

Proposed slots (all weekdays the week of Mar 22):
- Option A: Thu Mar 25 15:00–16:00 CET / 09:00–10:00 ET / 06:00–07:00 PT (fits your ET ask; early for PT)
- Option B: Thu Mar 25 16:00–17:00 CET / 10:00–11:00 ET / 07:00–08:00 PT (pushes EU slightly later; still within EU office hours)
- Option C: Wed Mar 24 18:00–19:00 CET / 12:00–13:00 ET / 09:00–10:00 PT (later EU, better for APAC attendees joining early evening JST)

If Ken must join after 02:00 PT, Option B or C would be better for interactive time. I've attached a quick timezone matrix to make the conversions explicit.

Two operational asks from our side:
1) Please confirm which option works for the majority (ET + EU live).
2) Let us know if procurement needs to be on the invite now or after the demo.

I'll stand up an invite tentatively for Option B and will update once we have confirmation.

Best,
